The '''Mark II World Rover''' was a type of exploration rover utilized by the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]]. The rover had multiple [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] packages placed on its underside, and was able to carry a drill for extracting samples from underground. The rover was able to travel over many types of rough terrain, and was fitted with vector nozzles for basic flight over inhospitable terrain.
